privacy_contract: Tracked path metadata and Git status fingerprints only; no raw file bodies, private source rows, secrets, credentials, or conversations were inspected or retained.

pilots.human_gate: Lowell retains adoption and release authority.
Qualified legal review and Lowell approval are required before adoption or legal conclusions.

acceptance_evidence.result: The deterministic router selects only term-supported producer families, then adds one distinct quality checker for material work.
Typed family, skill, pack, role, project, assurance, governance, and observation dependencies are projected as candidate evidence.
Every family exposes exactly one worker and a distinct independent checker; material producers are validated by the quality family.
Superseded is a governed lifecycle state, supersedes is a registered candidate edge, and sentinels can surface lifecycle changes without rewriting an active family.
Both live pilots preserved identical before/after Git fingerprints; family contracts require rollback and stop on source drift.

limitations: The pilot family recommendations are declared candidate scopes, not proof that every family should be activated for every task in either repository.
No code, policy, agent instruction, release, recurring schedule, plugin, or external system was changed.
LawFirm OS remains an incubating declaration and was not inspected.
authority_boundary: Pilot evidence supports human review only. DAD and each source repository retain their existing authority, and no pilot result authorizes adoption, mutation, release, security remediation, or legal conclusions.
